# Texas Capital's Rob C. Holmes on Moving to the Texas Stock Exchange


Published on Sep 14, 2026


Texas Capital Chairman, President & CEO Rob C. Holmes joins Romaine Bostick and Isabelle Lee on Bloomberg's "The Close" to discuss the firm switching its primary stock listing to the Texas Stock Exchange.


[Watch Interview](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-09-14/texas-capital-ceo-on-moving-to-the-texas-stock-exchange-video)
